questions.question: What kinds of projects are a good fit?
questions.answer: Custom software, SaaS products, web applications, API integrations, internal tools, MVPs, AI-assisted workflows, product rescue, and defined features in existing systems.

questions.question: Can an early idea be enough to start?
questions.answer: Yes. Begin with the intended user, important task, current state, constraints, and smallest complete workflow worth building.

questions.question: Does Muhammad work internationally?
questions.answer: Yes. Project work is available to founders and teams worldwide in English.

questions.question: How can a client start?
questions.answer: Email mabdullah.built@gmail.com or use the contact and booking links on abdullahbuilt.top.
